name: RTLLM
description: RTLLM is an open-source benchmark for evaluating large language models on the task of generating design RTL from natural language instructions. It assesses generated RTL on syntax, functionality, and design quality goals with quantitative metrics.
reputation: A specialized open-source benchmark used in research on code generation for hardware design and RTL synthesis.
notes: Includes a prompt engineering technique named self-planning that improves GPT-3.5 performance on the benchmark.
